edition: Silent Hill: Downpour (2012), Devil’s Pitstop Otherworld
generationHistory: Original ART92 and following ledgers record documentary deferral rather than an output refusal for this exact ID.
finding: Distinct, visible environmental manifestation. The retail screenshot and two hands-on frames converge on a small irregular dark center with asymmetric red/pink rays and local distortion. Render only that finite selection depiction. Save the open spatial extent and the environmental role. No body, arena, physical boundary or combat state.

citations.kind: Walkthrough identifies the first pursuit just after the rotating picture.

First-person report and original HD screenshots taken at Konami. Author names the red vortex and describes how the scene is drawn into it. Preview capture; the same visual appears in the released-game walkthrough.
Published game guide places the Void at the same pursuit. Public indexed text read; direct page access returned HTTP 403, and its illustrations were not used.

references.sourceKind: Native encounter screenshot from the published Downpour walkthrough (diner, after the rotating picture).
references.observation: At gameplay distance, crimson light breaks into radial bands around a small irregular dark core. The central interruption has no bodily outline. Murphy is out of this central crop. Floor illumination is seen below the effect in the parent image.

references.sourceKind: The photographers’ September 2011 hands-on session at Konami. Pre-release 1920×1080 capture, cited only with retail corroboration.
references.observation: Rays fan unevenly from a dark convergence; finer incandescent orange flecks appear through it. The brightly-lit pipes and chamber beyond are the environment. The player is outside nearly all this upper crop.

references.sourceKind: A second native capture from the same 2011 hands-on, at a different distance and angle.
references.observation: A dark point pinches and stretches parts of the scene. The displaced wall, rails and character remain scenery; their forms do not give the Void physical limbs. The effect tapers into patches and uneven streaks.

references.sourceKind: Previously documented in-game image in the Downpour bestiary, used for cross-checking the effect.
references.observation: The central dark interruption and red radial bands match the named walkthrough location. The bounded graphic is the visible core and inner emission only; the image does not establish a fixed total area of influence.

limits: The emission fades at different distances under different lighting; the alpha boundary and footprint in a roster portrait are representational choices, not fixed edges in the game.

The source is a screen-space environmental effect. The portrait cannot reproduce the true moving background refraction. The reviewed role is environmental-obstacle with no duel preparation or attacks.
outputReview: The small dark center and asymmetric extent of the broad red light bands are visible. The cutout includes no character, feet or background. A closer look shows simulated reddish haze at the rim instead of real-time refraction of scenery. This is a limited still of the visible effect.
